errata.orig:
0007 Start DS certificate enrollment: Indicates that the client needs
        to begin enrolling its DS certificate.  The PAL entry points to
        a /simpleenroll URI, which is defined in [RFC7030].
errata.correct:
0007 Start DS certificate enrollment: Indicates that the client needs
        to begin enrolling its DS certificate.  The PAL entry points to
        a /simpleenroll or a /fullcmc URI, both of which are defined in     [RFC7030].
errata.notes: Without this change and taking the 0006 definition into consideration, one might assume that a Simple PKI Request doesn't require the /csrattrs URI to be done beforehand, but the enrollment with a Full PKI Request must be preceded by the /csrattrs URI, which is not required - see the rest of the document, especially Section 9 and [RFC7030].
Make it clear which object identifier is associated with PIKData.
